name: Robotouille
description: Robotouille is a benchmark environment designed to test large language model agents' ability to handle long-horizon asynchronous planning scenarios, including managing overlapping tasks and interruptions. It includes synchronous and asynchronous datasets that capture increasingly complex planning challenges beyond existing benchmarks.
reputation: A very recent research benchmark with limited but growing adoption, mainly used in papers on long-horizon planning and agentic LLM evaluation.
notes: Highlights significant room for improvement in asynchronous planning capabilities of LLM agents.
